findings.title: Conditional size and colour are offered as deferred customer customization
findings.observed: On a clothing item whose product-type choice controls size, colour and name fields, selecting the item type exposed selectable 'المقاس: يُحدد عند طلب العميل' and equivalent colour deferral. Selecting size deferral succeeded and displayed the deferred-size status despite explanatory text requiring size/colour now. A second item's independent size had no deferral.
findings.root_cause_review: Backend establishes physical identity from variant selections or explicit inventory_role=physical. A visibility-connected component containing a text field and no recognized physical identity is inferred entirely as customization. The UI renders defer controls from defer_allowed. Missing physical designation on a conditional size/colour can therefore expose deferral.
confirmed_by_root: Live selectable size deferral and inconsistent guidance.
Exact-live-source classifier and UI rendering logic reread.
findings.independent_review: live_page_contracts reviewed same live SHA and validator paths; no source edits or live requests by reviewer.
findings.uncertainty: Live item metadata was not read directly. The precise missing/incorrect physical designation is not established. No save was attempted; acceptance of an invalid inventory entry by the backend is not claimed.
findings.existing_test_gap: Existing customization-inference test covers a proven physical variant dimension, not conditional size/colour in a text-connected component without physical evidence.
findings.next_safe_action: Prepare an isolated code correction and regression cases for mixed option groups with missing physical metadata. Preserve required physical dimensions and rerun targeted frontend/backend configuration gates before any separately coordinated release.
